name: Hive'Regal Scout Report
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence.  Scout Landion has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Regal for several days now.  Find him and obtain a written report.  We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Contact Cenarion Scout Landion inside Hive'Regal and return the Hive'Regal Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, adventurer. I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.
narrative.requestItemsText: You'll find Scout Landion inside Hive'regal. Hurry, adventurer! Time is of the essence.

giverName: an item: Tactical Task Briefing VII
startItemText: an item: Tactical Task Briefing VII
